description: This source file defines various attribute classes used to specify placement policies for grains in Orleans, such as random, hash-based, local preference, activation count-based, silo role-based, resource optimized, and immovability attributes. It also defines the base PlacementAttribute class and an enum for immovability kinds.

classes.name: PlacementAttribute
classes.description: An abstract base attribute class for all placement policy markers, defining a placement strategy and a method to populate grain properties.

classes.name: RandomPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating the grain uses the RandomPlacement policy, which is also the default policy.

classes.name: HashBasedPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating the grain uses HashBasedPlacement policy.

classes.name: PreferLocalPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating the grain prefers local placement.

classes.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating the grain uses activation count-based placement policy to balance grains based on active counts.

classes.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating the grain uses silo role-based placement policy.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating the grain uses resource-optimized placement policy.

classes.name: ImmovableAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating that activations of the grain should not be migrated automatically, with a specified immovability kind.

methods.name: PlacementAttribute..ctor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the placement strategy, throws if strategy is null.

methods.name: PlacementAttribute.Populate
methods.description: Method to populate grain properties based on the placement strategy.

methods.name: ImmovableAttribute..ctor
methods.description: Constructor setting the immovable kind, with a default of 'Any'.

methods.name: ImmovableAttribute.Populate
methods.description: Method to set the immovability property in the grain properties dictionary.
